Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Polyester Area Rug, 1' 8" x 2' 10", Silver, Grey, White
Materials: silver
Add the finishing touch to your home decor with this beautiful silver, gray, and white rug. With an engaging geometric pattern, this rug is an ideal accent for transitional-style interior design, and its small size makes it perfect for narrow floor spaces. 1'8" x 2'10" Imported; 49% polyester, 29% polypropylene, 16% jute, 6% cotton Machine made with a textured geometric pattern Medium .39" pile suits any indoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
